About the opportunity
A well-funded, high-growth robotics company is looking for a senior Physical AI Architect to help shape the future of real-world warehouse automation. This is a high-impact technical leadership role for someone who combines deep research-level understanding with strong product and deployment instincts.

The business is seeking someone who can bridge modern AI methods with the realities of production robotics translating advanced approaches in diffusion-based learning and optimal control into reliable, scalable behavior on physical systems. This role is ideal for someone who cares about shipping robust systems into demanding operational environments, not just building impressive demos.

What you’ll be doing

Own the end-to-end technical architecture across perception, planning, and control for production robotic systems
Lead the application of diffusion-based policy learning and optimal control to real-world manipulation and picking challenges
Define how learned policies and classical control methods should work together within a broader autonomy stack
Partner closely with software, firmware, mechanical, and systems teams to ensure AI design is grounded in hardware and operational constraints
Drive hardware/software co-design across sensors, compute, and actuation
Identify and resolve bottlenecks across inference, execution, control, and throughput
Act as a senior technical authority within the autonomy organization, helping shape roadmap and architecture decisions
Mentor experienced engineers and elevate overall technical depth across the team

What they’re looking for

Strong track record of deploying AI-powered robotic or autonomous systems into production
Advanced degree (ideally PhD) in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on industry experience
Deep expertise in diffusion models for robot learning, behavior generation, or planning
Strong grounding in optimal control, including MPC, trajectory optimization, and feedback control for physical systems
Practical understanding of how learned policies and model-based control can be combined effectively in real-world robotics
Experience integrating with physical robot platforms, including sensors, embedded compute, and actuator interfaces
Strong programming skills in Python and C++
Familiarity with ROS2 or similar robotics middleware
Experience working within real-time constraints and deploying learned systems onto hardware
Systems mindset with an emphasis on reliability, observability, safety, and maintainability
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional engineering decisions
